items.title: .name Termination
items.title_zh: Verisign 将终止 .name 三级域名注册
items.summary: Verisign is terminating registrations under the .name TLD's third-level domains (e.g., x.y.name), impacting existing users and raising stability/security concerns within ICANN governance.

items.title: Porting my 1993 Amiga game to Godot, with an LLM reading the 68000 assembly

items.summary: A developer documents porting his 1993 Amiga 68000 assembly game to Godot with the help of an LLM, successfully reconstructing and preserving a retro classic in an evening.
